description: This file contains Swift code for a macOS application implementing a web chat interface with UI components, transport layer for communication with the backend, and window management. It defines data structures, view controllers, transport protocol implementations, and logging setup related to the WebChatSwiftUI feature.

classes.name: WebChatSwiftUIWindowController
classes.description: A controller managing the presentation of the web chat UI window or panel, handling its creation, showing, hiding, positioning, and interactions with the underlying view.

methods.name: requestHistory
methods.description: Requests chat history for a given session key via the gateway connection.

methods.name: listModels
methods.description: Retrieves the list of available chat models from the backend.

methods.name: abortRun
methods.description: Aborts an ongoing chat run for a given session and run ID.

methods.name: listSessions
methods.description: Lists chat sessions with optional limit, utilizing the gateway connection.

methods.name: setSessionModel
methods.description: Sets or clears the model for a specific chat session.

methods.name: setSessionThinking
methods.description: Adjusts the thinking level setting for a session.

methods.name: sendMessage
methods.description: Sends a chat message with optional thinking level and attachments.

methods.name: requestHealth
methods.description: Checks health status of the backend service.

methods.name: resetSession
methods.description: Resets the chat session identified by session key.

methods.name: compactSession
methods.description: Compacts or cleans up a session.

methods.name: events
methods.description: Starts a stream of transport events from the gateway.

methods.name: mapPushToTransportEvent
methods.description: Converts a push message to an internal transport event.

methods.name: mapModelChoice
methods.description: Maps a protocol model choice to the chat model choice data structure.
